name: What is the difference between a cosmetic and a full bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a cosmetic and a full bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cosmetic bathroom renovation focuses on aesthetic upgrades without altering the layout or structural elements, such as painting, replacing fixtures, or updating tile. It's generally less intrusive and quicker. A full bathroom renovation, conversely, involves significant changes, including reconfiguring the layout, moving plumbing or electrical, replacing structural components, and often expanding the space. Full renovations offer a complete transformation and usually require more time, budget, and permitting due to their comprehensive nature.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cosmetic renovations update aesthetics without changing layout or structure. Full renovations involve significant layout, plumbing, and electrical changes, offering a complete transformation.
